en.description: Traweller helps a travel community log every journey, track trip status and discover where fellow members have been.

landing.headline: Every journey you take, remembered
landing.subheadline: Traweller is for travelers who keep a clear record of where they have been, what is planned next and what the community is exploring.
landing.featuresHeading: Everything you need to track your travels

features.title: Log any trip
features.description: Add a destination, travel dates, country and personal notes to build your complete travel record.

features.title: Track trip status
features.description: Move each trip from planned to ongoing to completed so your log always reflects where things stand.

features.title: Community routes
features.description: Browse featured routes that fellow trawellers have documented and add destinations to your own list.

features.title: Filter your history
features.description: Search and filter your past trips by country, date range or status in seconds.

howItWorks.heading: Up and running in four steps

steps.title: Sign in with Google
steps.description: Create your traweller account instantly using your existing Google credentials — no extra form to fill in.

steps.title: Add your first trip
steps.description: Enter a destination, the travel dates and any notes you want to keep, then save the trip to your log.

steps.title: Update the status
steps.description: Mark each trip as planned, ongoing or completed as your plans develop and journeys unfold.

steps.title: Explore the community
steps.description: Browse routes other trawellers have shared and discover destinations you have not yet considered.

items.question: Is traweller free to join?
items.answer: Sign in with your Google account and start logging trips straight away at no cost.

items.question: Who can see my trip log?
items.answer: Your personal trip log is private by default. Only the community routes you choose to contribute appear in the shared catalogue.

items.question: How many trips can I record?
items.answer: There is no limit — log every trip you have taken or plan to take, however far back or forward you want to go.

items.question: Can I edit a trip after saving it?
items.answer: Yes. Every field — destination, country, dates, status and notes — can be updated or corrected at any time from your dashboard.

items.question: What is the board view on the dashboard?
items.answer: The board groups your trips by status (planned, ongoing, completed) so you can see your entire travel pipeline at a glance.

listings.heading: Featured Community Routes
listings.intro: Explore travel routes that traweller members have documented — from short group tours to long solo overlands.
listings.notice: These routes are illustrative examples; real community-documented routes will appear here as members contribute them.

route-1.title: Balkan Backpacker Trail
route-1.summary: A two-week overland journey across the western Balkans, linking mountain villages, Adriatic coastal towns and historic city centres.

route-2.title: Mekong River Week
route-2.summary: Seven days following the Mekong from busy border towns to quiet floating markets, with shared stays and guided day excursions.

route-3.title: Andean High Route
route-3.summary: Three weeks crossing high-altitude passes, colonial cities and vast salt flats through the central Andes by foot and local bus.
